exercises.name: Make the D major shape

params.fingers: string 4: fret 0 finger 0; string 3: fret 2 finger 1; string 2: fret 3 finger 3; string 1: fret 2 finger 2

exercises.coaching: Bring your hand up to the neck. D major is just a shape — land the fingers, let the others ring open. That right there is a real chord.

exercises.name: One clean down-strum
exercises.purpose: Strum through the sounding strings without catching.
exercises.coaching: Keep that shape and strum straight down. Wrist loose. If a string buzzes, press a touch closer to the fret. When it rings clean, that is your first real win.
